title: 1 000 and 4 000 days of the Kremlin’s attacks against Ukraine’s sovereignty
text: EUvsDisinfo – analiza: 1 000 and 4 000 days of the Kremlin’s attacks against Ukraine’s sovereignty. Russia’s unprovoked war against Ukraine is not just a military invasion; it is a calculated attack on Ukraine’s sovereignty and its right to exist as an independent nation. Central to the Kremlin’s strategy in Ukraine is the persistent myth that Ukraine is not a real country —a narrative aggressively pushed to justify Russia’s imperial ambitions and undermine international support for Ukraine. Ultimatums and twisted histories fail to deliver results In December 2021, the Kremlin issued a set of ultimatums masquerading as demands for ‘security guarantees’. This was not a genuine plea for security, but a strategic attempt to deny Ukraine’s agency and sovereignty on the world stage. By attempting to dictate Ukraine’s foreign policy choices, Russia sought to reassert control over its neighbour and legitimise its decades-long interference in Ukraine’s internal affairs . These ultimatums served as a fabricated pretext for Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine just two months later. For over a decade now, Putin has repeatedly distorted history to claim that Ukraine was a creation of the Bolsheviks, ignoring centuries of Ukrainian culture and statehood . This deliberate manipulation aims to delegitimise Ukraine and rationalise Russia’s aggressive actions . Creeping attempt to redraw borders Russia flagrantly violated the 1994 Budapest Memorandum on security assurances where it pledged to respect Ukraine’s borders and sovereignty. The illegal annexation of Crimea in 2014 and the orchestration of sham referendums in the temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine are clear breaches of international law. These actions are accompanied by relentless war propaganda falsely portraying Ukraine as a puppet state controlled by foreign powers . The narrative of ‘ lost sovereignty ’ extends beyond Ukraine. The Kremlin employs it to undermine other neighbouring nations, suggesting they too lack true independence and are mere vassals of the West. This strategy aims to expand Russia’s influence and reassert its dominance over former Soviet territories and beyond. Ukraine stands firm Yet, Ukraine still stands. The resilience and determination of the Ukrainian people and their leadership underscore their unwavering commitment to their nation’s sovereignty and identity. Their courage exposes the Kremlin’s disinformation for what it is—a tool of aggression and imperial ambition .
